disposition_reason: Tables 1 and 2 print mean, SD, range and median concentrations of 26 elements, including lead, cadmium, arsenic and mercury, in 212 Australian retail honeys and by regional-origin class.

study.design: Retail market survey of honeys classified by regional origin (urban, peri-urban, rural, blend)
study.origin: Australia; urban, peri-urban, rural or unspecified (blend) regional origin
study.market: Queensland supermarkets, fruit shops, local markets and producers; urban honeys bought online
study.method: ICP-MS (Agilent 8800) after microwave nitric acid digestion for trace elements; ICP-OES after hot block digestion for Ca, K, Mg, Na, P
study.lod_text: LOR (10 x SD of 20 blanks, 1.0 g in 40 mL), mg/kg: As 0.005, Cd 0.005, Hg 0.005, Pb 0.005, others in Table 1
study.qa: Certified and in-house reference materials; SRM recoveries in supplementary Table S1 (not in the filed PDF)
